title: Paired
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 165
medium: Interactive page (index.html, SVG and DOM built in the browser): the visitor rates an animal picture for kawaii, then sees the Japanese adults' mean, the machine's own rating and its account of the people in three arms; the 24 contact pictures as told truly and as shuffled; all 48 pictures in one plot. A figure (figure.svg); 240 px pictures (public domain or CC0) and the makers' picture sheets; Python for keys, sheets and briefs, scoring, a labelled post-hoc reading, transcript extraction, face data and figure; briefs, verbatim replies and predictions; source hashes.
embodies: A machine practice handed a public's judgements on other things does not take them in: it checks them against its own eye. True pairs that agree are redundant; false pairs are recognised as noise and cost it nerve, not belief.
result: P1 held (account follows the family at 0.936, the people at 0.898). P2 failed: 24 true pairs added no order (0.899). P3 failed: shuffled pairs cost only 0.04 of order (0.856). P4 failed: shuffled contact raised the miss (MAE ratio 1.23). P5 failed. P6 failed: four of six shuffled makers said the numbers did not fit. P7 and P8 held. S163.ANCHOR falsified (error ratio 0.805; direction 29 of 29). S164.SHAPE held (0.945 vs 0.899). S165.CHECKED added.
project_step: Forty-fifth experiment of the project. Operation: perceiving (with judging). Takes up Session 164's open thread 1 (buy order with breadth: many keys told once instead of quartiles on two) and adds a shuffled-pairs control, experiment 33's SHUFFLE operator used as an instrument, to separate what contact teaches through its pairs from what it teaches through its numbers. Builds on experiments 43 and 44 (describer and anchor arms, tooling). Works against Cartography, not Tracing (ATP 12-13) in the making: the shuffled contact is a tracing of the real's statistics, and the family refused it as a map.
material: Nittono & Nakamura (2026), The Animal Affective Picture System (AAPS), PsyArXiv doi:10.31234/osf.io/qmjuk_v1, data osf.io/3uzrw (CC BY 4.0; pictures public domain or CC0): 914 Japanese adults, March 2026, 800 animal pictures on four 1-9 scales, about 57 ratings per picture; the kawaii scale only, 72 pictures by seed 165. Domain: cuteness, how kawaii a public finds an animal it is shown.
seed: prepare.py seed 165 (keys, contact set, arrangements); shuffle derangement seed 170 (first from 165 with |rho| <= 0.1); makers are model instances and not seeded
